Elon (Judge)
EE-lon
proper noun (OT judge)
Hebrew Elon (oak, great tree). Eleventh judge of Israel (Judges 12:11-12). A Zebulonite; judged Israel ten years; buried in Aijalon in the territory of Zebulun.

📖 Biblical Definition

Eleventh judge of Israel (Judges 12:11-12), following Ibzan. Elon the Zebulonite judged Israel ten years and was buried in Aijalon (place of deer) in the territory of Zebulun. The account is among the briefest in the entire book of Judges — just two verses. Like Tola before him, Elon is the model of the quiet judge whose decade of stable leadership is reported without recorded conflict, dramatic deliverance, or memorable speech. He simply judges Israel, dies, and is buried. The book of Judges presents these minor-judge accounts deliberately: the dramatic deliverers (Othniel, Ehud, Deborah, Gideon, Jephthah, Samson) are interspersed with the quiet stewards (Tola, Jair, Ibzan, Elon, Abdon) to show that the Lord's preservation of His people in the pre-monarchical period was not by dramatic deliverance alone but also by extended seasons of ordinary faithful governance. The patriarchal-Reformed reader recovers Elon as the steward whose long quiet leadership preserves God's people without making the headlines.

📜 Webster 1828 Definition

Eleventh judge of Israel (Judges 12:11-12); Zebulonite; ten-year reign; the briefest judges-account; quiet steward pattern.

ELON, proper n. (OT judge) Eleventh judge of Israel (Judges 12:11-12), following Ibzan. A Zebulonite. Judged Israel ten years and was buried in Aijalon (place of deer) in the territory of Zebulun. Among the briefest judge-accounts in the entire book (two verses). Like Tola, the model of the quiet judge whose decade of stable leadership preserves Israel without recorded conflict, dramatic deliverance, or memorable speech. The deliberate Judges-pattern of dramatic deliverer + quiet steward shows the Lord's preservation of His people by both dramatic and ordinary means.

📖 Key Scripture

Judges 12:11-12 — "And after him Elon, a Zebulonite, judged Israel; and he judged Israel ten years. And Elon the Zebulonite died, and was buried in Aijalon in the country of Zebulun."

Genesis 49:13 — "Zebulun shall dwell at the haven of the sea; and he shall be for an haven of ships; and his border shall be unto Zidon."

Deuteronomy 33:18-19 — "And of Zebulun he said, Rejoice, Zebulun, in thy going out; and, Issachar, in thy tents. They shall call the people unto the mountain; there they shall offer sacrifices of righteousness: for they shall suck of the abundance of the seas."

1 Thessalonians 4:11 — "And that ye study to be quiet, and to do your own business, and to work with your own hands, as we commanded you."

⚠️ Modern Corruption

No major postmodern redefinition. Elon is a quiet minor judge; the recovery is the appreciation of long ordinary faithful leadership as the Lord's means of preservation.

expand to see more

Elon as a proper name does not undergo lexical corruption. The principal contemporary mishandling is the modern preference for the dramatic-narrative biblical leader and the corresponding neglect of the Elon-type quiet steward. The book of Judges deliberately interleaves the dramatic deliverers with the quiet stewards; both are part of the Lord's pattern of preserving His people. The patriarchal-Reformed recovery is the appreciation of long faithful ordinary governance as itself a means of grace through which the Lord preserves His church and household across generations.
